summary.name: SaneClip
summary.one_liner: A Mac clipboard manager with encrypted, Touch ID-locked history, OCR capture, snippets and a paste stack, plus a free iPhone/iPad companion app.
use_cases: keep a searchable history of copied text and images on a Mac
protect copied passwords and secrets from being stored
paste plain text or transformed text (uppercase, JSON, strip HTML)
reuse templated snippets with date and time placeholders
fill forms by pasting queued items in order
summary.what_it_does: SaneClip stores text and image clipboard history on a Mac and lets you search it by content, OCR text, source app and pinned status. History can be locked with Touch ID or the Mac password and encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. It skips copies from password managers and flags sensitive data such as card numbers, SSNs and private keys for scheduled purging. Clipboard rules can strip tracking parameters from URLs and trim whitespace, and paste options include plain text, text transforms, a FIFO/LIFO paste stack and snippets with placeholders. An optional iCloud sync feeds a free iPhone and iPad companion app.
notable: Touch ID lock and AES-256-GCM encryption of clipboard history
Automatically skips password manager copies and flags sensitive data
Full source code on GitHub under PolyForm Shield licence
Free iPhone/iPad companion with optional iCloud sync
caveats: Pro is a $14.99 one-time purchase; after the 14-day free trial Pro is required to keep using its features
Requires macOS 14.0 (Sonoma) or later; the page says Apple silicon Mac for the app
Sync to iPhone requires the user's own iCloud account and is only active while the companion is in use
